title: Update Orchestrator Test to Remove `work_package_file`
description:

**Description:** Update the orchestrator deep agent integration test to remove `work_package_file` from the PM prompt string and add a `description` value since `description` becomes required.

- `orchestrator/tests/test_deep_agent_integration.py` — lines 1107-1112

**Deliverables:**
- `work_package_file='work/WP-001.md'` removed from the PM live-test prompt string

Line 1112 references `work_package_file` again in a verification instruction. Both are string literals within a single test function.
